title: pvRenameArrays
body:
## pvRenameArrays

Passes its input through unchanged except for array names. Each list property holds [current name, new name] pairs for one attribute type: points, cells, field data, graph vertices, graph edges or table rows. It accepts any data object, including composites and tables. Use it to give arrays the names a later step expects, e.g. to make datasets agree before pvAppendDatasets, or to replace solver names before export.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Each list is flat: current name, then new name, repeated. Schemaxis rejects a list with an odd number of entries (INVALID_LENGTH) before the node runs.
- New names must stay unique within an attribute type; renaming onto an existing name creates a clash.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `RenameArrays`. Identity: `filters/RenameArrays`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

```json
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }

```
